parts.title: Conversations
parts.instructions: Select the best response to each question.

paragraphs.text: Directions: You will hear some conversations between two or more people. You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speakers say in each conversation. Select the best response to each question and mark the letter (A), (B), (C), or (D) on your answer sheet. The conversations will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.

parts.title: Talks
parts.instructions: Select the best response to each question.

paragraphs.text: Directions: You will hear some talks given by a single speaker. You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speaker says in each talk. Select the best response to each question and mark the letter (A), (B), (C), or (D) on your answer sheet. The talks will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.

questions.prompt: What is the speaker mainly discussing?

options.label: The opening of a new bakery location

questions.prompt: What does the speaker ask the listeners to do?

options.label: Work on the dough before the regular items

questions.prompt: By what time must the first trays be in the oven?
What good news does the speaker share at the start of the meeting?

options.label: A new store branch has opened.
A new product line has launched.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker imply when she says, "our weekend afternoons already get very busy"?

options.label: The store will extend its hours.
Customers will face longer wait times.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker ask the listeners to do by the end of the week?
What is the broadcast mainly about?

options.label: The launch of a new bus route

questions.prompt: What are drivers advised to do?

According to the speaker, what will the listeners see first?

options.label: Tickets are required for an event.
The listeners should come back for a presentation.
